decision: Treat URL resolution and readable media-byte acquisition as independent gates.
Test JavaScript Worker transport before building a Pyodide mini-wheel.
Never commit cookies, OAuth data, secrets, signed media URLs, or private raw traces.

Under the browser-only constraints, ship direct progressive streaming and opaque-cache offline playback as the reliable path; expose native file download only when attachment behavior is positively detected.
Do not claim universal 1080p download or mux until Googlevideo media becomes readable to JavaScript. Gate D remains failed overall because D2 failed even though D3 passed with readable fixtures.
